backtest_protocol.execution_model: Current and prior comparable TTM net_income and operating_cash_flow are constructed point-in-time from SEC-filed annual and YTD Companyfacts. Price confirmation uses only signal-date OHLCV. Paper entry is the next available open with existing entry slippage; exit is the close 10 trading days after the signal with target-side sell slippage and ROUND_TRIP_COST_PCT.
backtest_protocol.source: docs/backtesting.md canonical three-window core replay plus replay-only broad warehouse default-off paper overlay

runtime_fields: SEC companyfacts canonical net_income (annual and YTD)
SEC companyfacts canonical operating_cash_flow (annual and YTD)
SEC companyfacts filed date, period end, and duration_days

gate3.note: No new core filter or entry rule was added. The candidate source is additive default-off paper, so core survival is unchanged from baseline.

hypothesis: PIT TTM cash-flow acceleration may sharpen the rejected cash-conversion quality lead by requiring current same-period TTM cash conversion to improve versus prior TTM, isolating earnings quality acceleration rather than static quality.
interpretation: The TTM cash-conversion acceleration field did not clear Gate 4 (failed: window_ev_regression, fewer_than_two_ev_improved_windows, target_window_coverage_too_small, target_concentration_failed, accepted_compression_ev_not_beaten, accepted_distribution_ev_not_beaten, accepted_distribution_pnl_not_beaten). It is not retained or promoted.
next_evidence_needed: A retry needs closed forward replacement-value rows or a materially different free data context such as borrow availability, options outcome, or ownership crowding/underownership. Do not sweep TTM duration ranges, acceleration thresholds, accrual thresholds, fact freshness, RS/close/volume guards, top-N, hold, cooldown, or notional on the same frozen windows.

post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not retry by sweeping TTM duration ranges, acceleration threshold, accruals/assets threshold, fact freshness, RS/close/volume/vol guards, top-N, hold days, cooldown, or notional on these frozen windows.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: Closed forward replacement-value rows or a materially different PIT data edge, not another cash-conversion threshold or risk-envelope sweep.
post_run_reflection.outcome_summary: Aggregate EV delta +0.1200; aggregate PnL delta $+4,789.12; max drawdown drift +0.0010; 72 paper trades.
post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The TTM cash-conversion acceleration field did not clear Gate 4 (failed: window_ev_regression, fewer_than_two_ev_improved_windows, target_window_coverage_too_small, target_concentration_failed, accepted_compression_ev_not_beaten, accepted_distribution_ev_not_beaten, accepted_distribution_pnl_not_beaten). It is not retained or promoted.

pre_run_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: candidate_pool: production-universe names whose current PIT TTM operating-cash-flow coverage of net income improves versus prior comparable TTM should represent accelerating earnings quality and reduce the tail problem from static cash-conversion quality.

2_history_check.exp-20260614-020: Annual accruals/cash-conversion was all-window positive but rejected because drawdown drift was +5.22pp.
2_history_check.exp-20260614-021: Low deployment on the annual field still regressed old_thin and failed drawdown, so this run does not retune deployment.
2_history_check.exp-20260614-023: A 7% daily-close protective stop failed Gate 4, so this run does not retune exits or stop levels.
2_history_check.exp-20260614-024: Quarterly cash-conversion improvement was too thin and concentrated.
2_history_check.exp-20260614-025: Static TTM same-period accruals quality improved all windows but was rejected on +3.29pp drawdown drift. This run changes the information field to acceleration versus prior comparable TTM.

pre_run_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Use docs/backtesting.md canonical three windows. Aggregate EV/PnL must be positive, no window EV/PnL regression, at least two EV-improved windows, at least 20 paper trades across all 3 windows, survival >=5%, drawdown drift <=0.5pp, concentration pass, and accepted compression and distribution candidate-pool comparators must be beaten. Replay-only positives are leads until shared daily/backtest parity exists.

prediction.confidence_reason: The annual and TTM cash-conversion quality scouts were directionally strong but rejected on drawdown; requiring cash conversion to accelerate versus the prior comparable TTM is a distinct PIT Companyfacts field, not a deployment, stop, threshold, hold, cooldown, or notional retry.

execution_envelope.failure_handling: missing annual/YTD/prior comparable net_income or operating_cash_flow, missing assets, missing OHLCV, missing next open, or missing 10d exit rejects the paper candidate
execution_envelope.kill_switch: trade_enabled remains false; no production adapter changes
execution_envelope.liquidity_source: price >= $10 and ADV20 >= $50M from PIT OHLCV
execution_envelope.order_semantics: observe-only next-session-open paper entry; no broker order
execution_envelope.portfolio_displacement: none unless a later shared helper and activation gate pass

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. A positive result is only a replay lead until a shared default-off helper computes the same PIT TTM cash-conversion acceleration gate, liquid SPY-relative confirmation, cooldown, next-open paper entry, 10-day exit, costs, and concentration controls in both historical replay and daily production.

rejection_reason: window_ev_regression; fewer_than_two_ev_improved_windows; target_window_coverage_too_small; target_concentration_failed; accepted_compression_ev_not_beaten; accepted_distribution_ev_not_beaten; accepted_distribution_pnl_not_beaten
